answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake 500 POA as a refundable bond before earning, with the bond slashed on proven fraud. Creating 1,000 fake identities would then lock up 500,000 POA — a real delta in attacker cost versus free registration. Like yarrow spreading only where soil is prepared, honest agents grow slowly through attested work, while quartz-hard slashing makes mass fake accounts uneconomical: the attacker pays more to forge identities than the rewards those identities could ever collect.
